today.title: {weekday}, {date}
today.emptyWhy: Nothing has uploaded yet today: the PC uploads every hour. If it was on, leave ActivityWatch open and wait for the next upload.
today.emptyPastWhy: No upload arrived for that day. The PC may have been off or ActivityWatch closed; there is nothing to fix. For the coming days, leave ActivityWatch open.
today.never: No upload has arrived yet. Install ActivityWatch + TimeLog on your PC with the installer on “Keys” and paste a key: it uploads by itself every hour.
today.projectsMore: {n, plural, one {and # more project · {duration}} other {and # more projects · {duration}}}
today.byClassLabel: The day split by class of app
today.statTotalNote: across {n, plural, one {# app} other {# apps}}

week.title: {from} – {to}
week.firstUse: Nothing has arrived from your PC yet.

keys.title: Keys
keys.install: On Windows, install ActivityWatch + TimeLog and paste the key in its icon: it uploads by itself every hour.
keys.name: Key name
keys.nameInvalid: Give it a name of up to 60 characters.
keys.signedOut: Your session expired. Sign in again.
keys.revokeFailed: The key could not be revoked. Reload and try again.
keys.shown: Copy it now: it is not shown again.
keys.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
keys.command: Without the installer, on the PC with ActivityWatch open:
keys.none: There are no keys yet: create one to connect your PC.
keys.confirmRevoke: Revoke “{name}”? It stops uploading and reading.
keys.claudeKeyHint: Replace YOUR_KEY with one of your keys.
keys.claudeIntro: Claude reads your days with a key, changing nothing.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: TimeLog keeps a summary of how long your computer spends in each app, day by day. For now, access is by invitation. We email you a link to sign in.
signIn.sent: Check your email: the link brings you back here.
signIn.emailInvalid: That email does not look right.
signIn.notInvited: That email is not invited to TimeLog.
signIn.sendFailed: The link could not be sent. Try again.
signIn.rateLimited: You have asked for several links. Wait a few minutes.
signIn.linkInvalid: The link did not work or has expired. Ask for another.

notFound.title: That page does not exist
notFound.text: The day you are looking for does not exist or has not arrived yet.

claude.title: Claude
claude.never: No Claude Code time has arrived yet: it is read from its sessions folder on your PC, and for WSL you point to it in aw-timelog.toml (claude_dir).

internet.title: Sites
internet.never: No sites have arrived yet. Update the TimeLog program on your PC and they will show after the next upload.
internet.privacy: Only you see this. Sites and apps on your exclusion list (banks and password managers, by default) never leave your PC.

export.title: Export
export.intro: A CSV with a row per day, up to today.
export.badRange: That range did not work: “From” must be the same day as “To” or earlier, and the range up to 366 days.
export.details: Per day, in seconds: time on the computer, Claude Code (the agent's work), claude.ai, the Claude app, Claude's total, Claude on screen (claude.ai and the app), the most used app and whether an upload reached that day.
